name: restaurant
description: Restaurant ordering app. Frontend (React/Vite) in ./frontend, backend (Express + real-time SSE) in ./backend. `npm run dev` starts both.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
